278288257.description:
A single bookend cut from a half agate geode from Brazil, with a polished face showing white and gray quartz crystal banded by tan and rust colored agate. The rough natural rind is left on the curved outer edge, and the flat cut side stands upright without a base. A small oval foil label reading semi precious stones made in Brazil and a handwritten paper tag are affixed to one side, and a teal felt pad is attached to the bottom. Sold as a single piece, not a pair.

Condition: Natural pits, chips and mineral roughness along the uncut rind. The felt bottom pad is worn and soiled, and the paper label is aged with a torn corner.

Artist Unknown
Natural Agate Geode Slice Set
Polished Stone with Copper Foil Edging
6.5" x 5.5"
Unsigned
This collection of six natural agate geode slices showcases a sophisticated array of geological formations, featuring intricate banding and crystalline centers in a palette of warm ochre, sienna, and translucent cream. Four specimens are enhanced with a hand-applied copper foil perimeter, a technique that provides a modern, metallic contrast to the organic, rugged textures of the stone's exterior. The slices demonstrate characteristic chalcedony layering and varied mineral density, typical of high-quality volcanic geodes.
Set includes four copper-foiled slices and two natural specimens with varied finishes
Translucent centers exhibit excellent light transmission, revealing fine internal structures
Ideal for use as decorative coasters, display specimens, or lapidary art bases
Largest piece measures approximately 6.5" x 5.5" x 1"
Condition:
Good pre-owned condition. The stones exhibit natural surface variations, inclusions, and minor internal fissures typical of geological specimens. The copper foil shows light oxidation and surface wear at the edges but remains structurally secure. One specimen is partially unfinished.
